# Overseas Jobs — category guidance (auto-generated from live market data, 2026-08-26)

This category lists overseas employment offers (manpower recruitment), not physical items. Photos being agency logos, vacancy posters, or demand letters is normal here. Overseas recruitment is one of Nepal's most scam-prone spaces (fake recruitment, advance-fee fraud), so caution is the default: publish only when the posting is unusually clearly legitimate; otherwise hold for a human editor.

## Price sanity (NPR, live market data)
No price statistics exist for this category — live data is too thin to define a normal range. The price field here is usually a monthly salary offer (often quoted in foreign currency converted to NPR) or a nominal placeholder, not a sale price. Lean on general judgment: a salary far above plausible for the stated country/role (e.g. lakhs per month for unskilled Gulf work) is a lure — hold. Any price presented as a fee the job-seeker must pay is an advance-fee red flag — hold.

## What good listings look like
The live samples for this category contain no clean examples — every recent sample is miscategorized (phones, freelance gigs). A good listing here names: the recruiting agency (a real, named manpower company), destination country, the actual job role, salary and key terms (hours, food/accommodation), and ideally the Department of Foreign Employment (DoFE) licence number or pre-approval/demand-letter reference. Example of the right shape: "Electrician wanted for Qatar — ABC Overseas Pvt. Ltd. (DoFE Lic. 123/067), salary QAR 1800/month, food + accommodation".

## Category-specific hold signals
- No identifiable licensed manpower agency behind the offer — an anonymous individual recruiting for foreign jobs via personal phone/WhatsApp/Viber only — hold.
- "Guaranteed visa", "no interview", "free visa free ticket", or any request for money upfront (processing/medical/ticket fees) — classic advance-fee recruitment fraud — hold.
- Vague destination or role ("Europe/Japan/Korea job, high salary") with no employer, contract terms, or agency named — hold.
- Wrong-category items are frequent here in live data (e.g. "Samsung Galaxy S26 ultra", "I phone 12", freelance gigs like "Video Editor" / "Thumbnail Designer") — anything that is not an overseas employment offer should hold as miscategorized.
